title: Fernling at Dusk — role correction v2

setting.mapIntent: An isolated candidate map using the meadow biome, existing map format, static landmark sprites, a scene-event dialogue trigger, and the existing chest contract.
placementConstraints: Use a small pack-owned meadow map titled Sunlit Trail — Dusk; do not copy the shipped Mossvale map.
Keep the traveler and Fernling together in one quiet, accessible spot; no movement choreography.
The chest is optional and can be approached independently of the conversation.

participants.identity: A road-worn traveler in a patched green coat, carrying a rolled bedroll and a heavy pack.
participants.role: A friendly stranger with a small puzzle about the trail's evening hush.
participants.startingSituation: Standing still as a static traveler landmark on reachable ground.

participants.identity: The player’s active companion; species comes from the selected adventure.
participants.role: Player-owned witness, not the traveler’s familiar.
participants.startingSituation: Following the player; fallback artwork never replaces a live selected companion.

traits.value: Only when the selected companion is Fernling.

uses.purpose: Show the traveler using the supplied traveler appearance.
Use the supplied wooden chest appearance for the optional chest.
Place the existing tiled cottage sprite as scenery on the pack-owned dusk map.
Place the existing oak sprite as scenery on the pack-owned dusk map.
Present the three repeatable dialogue lines through the existing map scene-event action.
Configure a static traveler sprite as a sign-role landmark, whose existing interaction displays dialogue without opening the ranger menu.
uses.configurationIntent: The trigger uses map landmark id traveler as its dialogue speaker.

beats.intent: The traveler welcomes the player and introduces the unusual quiet of the trail.
beats.speaker: trail-traveler
beats.text: Evening. Your companion usually stirs at every rustle, but tonight it is watching the hill.

beats.intent: The traveler shares a gentle, unresolved mystery without claiming a supernatural event.
beats.speaker: trail-traveler
beats.text: I heard a second set of footsteps after mine stopped. I looked back; the path was empty. Maybe the wind has learned our pace.

beats.intent: The traveler is reassured by the alertness of the player’s companion, without acquiring ownership of it.
beats.speaker: trail-traveler
beats.text: Your companion heard them too? Then I will not blame the wind just yet. Keep your ears open, friend.

beats.intent: Allow the player to inspect and open the existing treasure chest if they choose.
beats.interactionIntent: Interact with the treasure chest on Sunlit Trail.
beats.expectedResult: The existing chest interaction offers its authored coins, potions, or orbs reward once; this optional interaction does not gate the conversation.

completion: The conversation ends after the traveler's farewell. The player may leave or separately open the existing chest; the encounter requires no combat, movement choreography, new effects, or save-state assumptions.
